policy_name: MiraVerse v1.2 Epistemic Verification & Reviewer Workflow Policy

rules.title: No Automatic Confidence Upgrade from Essay Tone
rules.description: Assertions in the uploaded essay (Pasted text(1).txt) start as source_asserted_unverified or disputed with confidence low/medium unless corroborated by an independent reference.

rules.title: Strict Myth / Landscape vs Historical Claim Separation
rules.description: Isis/Osiris at Byblos and Adonis/Afqa red river sediment are classified as mythology or interpretation, never literal historical events.

rules.title: Numerical & Anecdotal Claim Quarantine
rules.description: Gold-weight translation payments, 1258 river-of-ink tropes, 972 CE fanous single-origin stories, exact Lyon traboule counts (~400-500), and competing bibimbap origin theories are explicitly flagged as contested_history or source_asserted_unverified.

rules.title: Bibliographic Candidates vs Verified Citations
rules.description: Named books and authors in the essay (Amin Maalouf, Rabih Alameddine, Kahlil Gibran, Beau Beausoleil, Michelle Zauner, Siuijeonseo) are stored as entity_type=work/person with rights.text=paraphrase_only and verified=false until original editions are examined.

rules.title: Child Safety, Religious Neutrality & Trauma Prevention
rules.description: No graphic depiction of the 2007 Al-Mutanabbi attack or WWII persecution; no forced religious observance in Ramadan/Chuseok/Epiphany activities; no collection of real child voice recordings or family PII; virtual cooking safety flags for heat and raw ingredients.
